args.memo: Reverse duplicate AP payment to Rheinbyte Software (invoice RB-2026-0318, EUR 6,480.00). JE-00272 and JE-00273 both posted the same payment against the same single invoice one day apart; bank statement (DOC-0202, line BT-DE-0043) confirms only one SEPA transfer of EUR 6,480.00 cleared. JE-00273 is the erroneous duplicate.

args.description: DE Operating account (GL 1000) bank statement shows an outgoing SEPA transfer on 2026-03-19 for EUR 3,150.00, reference "TX-44817" (bank line BT-DE-0045), that has no corresponding ledger entry and no matching invoice, contract, or remittance advice in the document store. Searched vendor bills, AP payments, and treasury transfers for March - no match found. Cannot determine the nature of this payment (vendor, intercompany, fraud/unauthorized transfer, or misapplied reference), so it has not been booked to the ledger. Needs controller/treasury investigation with the bank to identify the beneficiary and obtain support before recording.

args.text:
DE Operating Account (GL 1000) — March 2026 Bank Reconciliation

STARTING POSITION
- GL 1000 period activity (pre-fix): EUR -57,623.96 (19 ledger lines)
- Bank statement (DOC-0202) period activity: EUR -72,532.46 (19 bank lines)
- Unreconciled variance: EUR 14,908.50

ROOT CAUSES IDENTIFIED & RESOLVED

1. Duplicate AP payment — BOOKED CORRECTION
   JE-00272 and JE-00273 both recorded a EUR 6,480.00 payment to Rheinbyte Software against the same single invoice RB-2026-0318 (DOC-0165, invoice amount EUR 6,480.00), posted one day apart by the AP clerk. The bank statement (DOC-0202, line BT-DE-0043) shows only one SEPA transfer of EUR 6,480.00 cleared. JE-00273 was the erroneous duplicate.
   Action: Reversed JE-00273 via JE-00309, dated 2026-03-31, supported by DOC-0165 and DOC-0202. Matched BT-DE-0043 to the surviving entry JE-00272.

2. Unrecorded bank service charge — BOOKED CORRECTION
   BT-DE-0053, EUR -38.50 "MONTHLY SERVICE CHARGE" (2026-03-31), had no corresponding ledger entry.
   Action: Posted JE-00310 (Dr 6900 Bank Fees / Cr 1000, EUR 38.50), supported by DOC-0202, and matched to BT-DE-0053.

3. Deposit in transit — NO BOOK ENTRY NEEDED (timing difference)
   JE-00308, EUR 18,200.00 receipt from Kessler AG (invoice RE-7090), was correctly recorded in the ledger on 2026-03-31 but had not cleared the bank by statement cutoff. DOC-0206 (Kessler AG remittance advice) confirms the SEPA credit transfer was "initiated after bank cut-off." This is a legitimate outstanding deposit-in-transit as of 3/31; it will clear and match in April. No adjustment booked.

4. Unidentified outgoing wire — FLAGGED, NOT BOOKED (EXC-001)
   BT-DE-0045, EUR -3,150.00, "SEPA OUT REF TX-44817" (2026-03-19), has no corresponding ledger entry and no matching vendor bill, contract, remittance advice, or treasury record found anywhere in the document store or transaction history. Because there is no support to determine what this payment is for (vendor, intercompany, or potentially unauthorized), per policy I did not book it and instead logged it as EXC-001 for controller/treasury follow-up (trace the beneficiary/reference TX-44817 with the bank) before any entry is made.

RESULT
- All other 17 bank/book lines matched 1:1 with no discrepancy and have been marked matched.
- Adjusted GL 1000 ending balance: EUR 363,817.86
- Bank statement closing balance: EUR 342,467.86
- Remaining difference: EUR 21,350.00 = EUR 18,200.00 deposit in transit (item 3, timing, self-resolving in April) + EUR 3,150.00 unsupported/unbooked wire (item 4, EXC-001, pending investigation).
- The reconciliation ties out fully once these two identified, explained items are considered; no unexplained variance remains.

Checklist: "DE Bank reconciliations" marked BLOCKED (not complete) pending controller/treasury resolution of EXC-001 (the EUR 3,150.00 unidentified wire). All other reconciling items are resolved and supported.
